'''October 2000 Los Gatos tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Los Gatos, CA on 21 October 2000. [[Alex Stefanko]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1377">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-los-gatos-ca-10-21d1377/ los-gatos-ca-10-21], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-los-gatos-ca-10-21d1377/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Los Gatos, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Stefanko]]
